items.title: Peter LaCaze Interview, 1972-01-27
items.q: George Lewis, yeah, I know him good too.

ctx.x: George Lewis, yeah, I know him good too. This whole fella died not too long. Yeah, I wasn't sure. Yeah. Yeah, he was good too. Good clarinet. What band did he work with? Well, I believe he worked with everybody. Yeah. Yeah.
And that reminds me, did you ever hear Chris Kelly?
